description: This PHP class 'CommonParams' defines a set of constants used as common parameter keys for API interactions within the OrangeHRM system. It serves as a utility class to standardize parameter names like 'id', 'ids', 'empNumber', etc., across the codebase.

classes.name: CommonParams
classes.description: A final class providing constant parameter names for API requests such as 'id', 'ids', 'empNumber', etc.
